listing.name: Dune II (OpenDUNE)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Native original-engine recreation with explicit v1.07 data and Windows/macOS archives. Limits: Distinct implementation from Dune Dynasty and from OpenRA Dune 2000; older releases. Upstream platforms: Windows i686/x86-64 and macOS PowerPC/i686/x86-64 documented build targets; Linux source route. Selected historical archive CPUs require asset choice. Original data: Distinct implementation from Dune Dynasty and from OpenRA Dune 2000; older releases. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
